commands.review_summary:
The PR changes `codexbar serve` timeout/cache handling to retain in-flight keys after request timeouts and adds `CLIServeRouterTests` for cooperative and uncooperative timeout cleanup.

Reproducibility: yes. for the PR defects by source inspection: make a serve request time out while `makeResponse` ignores cancellation, then the cleanup task can remain stuck before `releaseInFlight` and later same-key requests wait outside their own deadline. I did not run tests because this review must keep the checkout read-only.

target.title: Fix serve deadline leaving orphan in-flight work
target.body:
## Summary

Addresses a plausible `codexbar serve` leak path from #1999 without regressing the documented `--request-timeout` contract.

When serve hit its request deadline, the old code returned 504 immediately but cleared the cache in-flight flag while canceled provider work kept running. A later refresh could start a second fetch on top of the first.

This revision:
- **Returns 504 immediately** on timeout (no drain of canceled work before the response).
- **Keeps the cache key in-flight** until canceled work exits or the cleanup grace (`requestTimeout`) elapses, so a second fetch cannot stack on the same key.
- Adds regression tests for cooperative cleanup, uncooperative producers, in-flight retention, and same-key sequential timeouts.

Does not claim to close #1999 without the maintainer-requested Jetsam/process diagnostics.

## Behavior proof (local, 2026-07-09)

```
swift test --filter 'serve deadline returns before uncooperative|timed out serve retains|sequential serve deadline timeouts on one key'

✔ serve deadline returns before uncooperative work finishes passed after 0.105s
✔ timed out serve retains in-flight until cleanup releases the cache key passed after 0.313s
✔ sequential serve deadline timeouts on one key do not stack in-flight work passed after 0.927s
```

The uncooperative test uses a dispatch-queue delay that ignores task cancellation; the 504 still returns in ~100ms instead of waiting 1s.

## Test plan

- [x] `swift test --filter CLIServeRouterTests` (45 tests)
- [x] `serve deadline returns before uncooperative work finishes`
- [x] `serve deadline cancels cooperative in-flight work after timeout`
- [x] `timed out serve retains in-flight until cleanup releases the cache key`
- [x] `sequential serve deadline timeouts on one key do not stack in-flight work`
